name: friday
description: F.R.I.D.A.Y. — Local persistent personal AI assistant with three-tier neural memory, subconscious dreaming, specialist Worker orchestration, and omnichannel IM gateway

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(m => m.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-web.mjs
scripts.check:plugins: tsc -p tsconfig.plugins.json --noEmit && python3 -m py_compile plugins/health-scale/ble_helper.py && bash -n tools/tv-agent-apk/build.sh
scripts.check:apk: bash -c 'if command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.local/jdk17/bin/javac" ]; then if [ -d "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}}/platforms" ]; then bash tools/tv-agent-apk/build.sh >/dev/null; fi; fi'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.plugins.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:plugins && npm run check:apk && npm test
